author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
In this live stream excerpt, Adam Savage reflects on the pivotal transition from making things as a hobby into a full-time career, sharing stories about the pressure of working on commercial sets, what he learned alongside Jamie Hyneman, and the moment he realized obsession could become a livelihood. With thanks to crispychrissy for the question and support! Do you have experience making your hobby into a career?
